title: All Hail the Power of Jesus’ Name
description: All Hail the Power of Jesus’ Name in Tonic Solfa to CORONATION, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, four verses and a piano.
about: Edward Perronet, who worked with John and Charles Wesley, published the hymn in 1779 and 1780; John Rippon reworked it in his selection of 1787, and most books print a mix of the two. Oliver Holden, an American carpenter and singing teacher, published the tune CORONATION in 1793.
With CORONATION the last two lines of every verse are sung twice. In Britain the words are also sung to MILES LANE or DIADEM.

lines: All hail the power of Jesus’ name!
And crown Him Lord of all.
verses.note: With this tune the last two lines of every verse are sung twice.

lines: Ye chosen seed of Israel’s race,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.
And crown Him Lord of all.
O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall!
And crown Him Lord of all.
